newsitem.title: UK: EU 14 refinery runs down by 1.5 pct in Jan vs Dec.
newsitem.headline: EU 14 refinery runs down by 1.5 pct in Jan vs Dec.

text.p: Refinery output in the European Union fell by 1.5 percent in January to 12.079 million barrels per day (bpd) in January from December's revised level of 12.269 million bpd, Stichting Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
Although output was 190,000 bpd down from December it was up 2.8 percent or some 330,000 bod on January 1996, the report said.
Gasoline output fell 18,000 bpd or 0.6 percent in January to 3.219 million bpd from December but was 1.1 percent higher than year ago levels.
Middle distillate output was 22,000 bpd above December's level and some 272,000 bpd above year ago levels.
Fuel oil output fell a big 4.5 percent or 79,000 bpd in Janaury from December level and was 125,000 bpd below January 1996 output.
The figures are for the 14 nations of the European Union, excluding Sweden.
The figures assume nameplate capacity of 12.6 million bpd. Refinery intake represents crude only and excludes natural gas liquids, feedstocks and other inputs.
